name: PhD in Biostatistics
summary: Biostatistics PhD training in statistical theory, methodology and applications in interdisciplinary health research.
detailsNote: Fall 2027 deadline confirmed; admission model not stated on opened official sources.

applicationFee.note: SOPHAS first designation$155; additional$65 per Dornsife FAQ. Limited waivers based on financial, service or international criteria; contact SOPHAS.

english.note: Dornsife international page describes competitive targets, not universal admission minimums. Scores within two years; U.S. degree exemption may apply. FAQ mentions Duolingo but specific international page names TOEFL/IELTS; confirm alternatives.

documents: Official transcripts from all college-level institutions; foreign credential evaluation
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s or master’s; strong math/statistics and practical/professional/research background. One year calculus including multivariate, linear algebra and calculus-based probability/statistics; prerequisite average at leastB+. SOPHAS application; one program designation.

funding.note: 2027–2028 acceptance contingent on pending funding lines; part-time/self-pay applicants encouraged. Applicants automatically reviewed for assistantships (tuition remission, insurance subsidy, stipend for20hours/week work); renewals depend on performance and funding. Universal funding not promised.
